decisions.reason: The bio-based bitumen binder remains a showcased flagship, but it sits far from the core plastic and oil recycling technology and faces slow adoption in construction, so withdrawal risk is elevated though not yet decisive.
The infectious waste decontamination plant, built with the partner ERMAFA, extends the core WASTX line into a regulated market with steady demand, so keeping it is justified.
The mobile SNOWFLAKE plant fits the decentralized modular strategy directly and also serves as a pretreatment stage for other WASTX systems, making it a low-risk core extension.
